description: Standard developer seed patterns — baked into binary, executed natively

steps: write {pkg_name}/{pkg_name}.go with package declaration + exported types
define handler: func handle{Name}(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request)
write FAILING test that reproduces the bug
read ALL involved files in one batch
create new package with extracted code
update old files to import new package
identify: does any goroutine Lock() a mutex held by its spawner?
pattern: snapshot under lock → release → goroutines with WaitGroup

anti_patterns.duplicate_types: NEVER define the same type in multiple files. Define once, import everywhere.
anti_patterns.lock_in_goroutine: NEVER spawn goroutines that Lock() a mutex already held by the spawner.
anti_patterns.guess_file_content: NEVER guess file content for search_replace. ALWAYS read first.
anti_patterns.sequential_tools: NEVER call tools one-by-one when they're independent. Batch them.
anti_patterns.infinite_retry: NEVER retry the same failing operation more than 3 times. Simplify approach.
anti_patterns.write_before_read: NEVER write a file you haven't read in this session.
